The transmitter of an Offset Time Base (Time Master) shall perform the following steps to distribute the Offset Time Base exactly: • Retrieve current Offset Time via StbM_GetOffset • Write seconds portion of the Offset Time to the OfsTimeSec field • Write nanoseconds portion of the Offset Time to the OfsTimeNSec field
